name: @ahegyes/wordpress-configs
description: Shared baseline configurations for Node-ecosystem tooling used by DWS WordPress plugins.

scripts.packages-update:all: composer packages-update && npm run packages-update && npm run packages-update:wp
scripts.lint:config: node -e "import('./node/eslint.config.base.mjs').then((m) => { if (!Array.isArray(m.default) || 0 === m.default.length) { throw new Error('eslint base did not export a flat-config array'); } }).catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })" && stylelint --print-config tests/fixtures/node-config/probe.css --config node/stylelint.config.base.js > /dev/null && tsc --noEmit -p tests/fixtures/node-config/tsconfig.json && node -e "require('./node/playwright.config.base.js')"
scripts.lint:all: composer lint:php && npm run lint:scripts && npm run lint:config
